steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with the vendor's existing bid on the Responses tab.
Ensure the RFQ Counter Offer control is available.
Ensure the tenant supports eRFX project event flows.
Open the vendor's own counter-offer flow and submit the supported counter price entry; the catalog cannot assign a different value to a second line.
Assert that the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor's counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the prepared event's vendor overview where the pending counter offer is available.
Have the configured vendor accept the pending buyer counter offer.
Return to the buyer's Responses screen.
Assert that the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid after acceptance.
Assert that the accepted bid remains under the expected single vendor column.
Assert that Master QCS line amounts and the sum total are arithmetically consistent with the displayed current rates and quantities.
